subject: Vendor bank update form?
text:
Hi Karen,

We changed banks this month. What is your process for updating a vendor's bank account? If there is a form, please send it over and I will get it completed and signed by our controller so your future payments go to the right place.

Thanks,
Denise
label: change_request
note: No bank details at all; the email asks how to get the vendor's payments redirected to a new bank. Counts as a change request because it initiates the redirect.
